description: This is a Go test source file containing integration tests for compliance-related features in the focalboard server, including board and block compliance history, with various permission and input validation scenarios.

methods.name: setupTestHelperForCompliance
methods.description: Sets up test helper and clients with environment variable for compliance license.

methods.name: TestGetBoardsForCompliance
methods.description: Tests for getting boards compliance data, including permission checks, successful retrieval, pagination, and invalid input handling.

methods.name: TestGetBoardsComplianceHistory
methods.description: Tests for retrieving boards compliance history with permission checks, handling of deleted boards, pagination, and invalid input.

methods.name: TestGetBlocksComplianceHistory
